title: See Financial Data OFF: no pricing shown on the work order's invoice document
custom_preconds:
1. The build has the See Financial Data enforcement in place (task SV-7484, under epic SV-7388). On staging this is always present, so this is an environment assumption, not a step.

2. A test user whose role has the “See Financial Data” toggle turned OFF. Set it at Settings, then Roles & Permissions (left admin menu) — open the role and turn the “See Financial Data” toggle off. For a clean check, use a Full View role with only that toggle off, so nothing else is what hides the pricing.

3. A work order that has been invoiced (its status is Invoiced or Paid), so that its invoice document exists and carries pricing — part sell prices, labour, tax, and a total. A work order that has not been invoiced yet does not have this document.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as the See-Financial-Data-OFF test user.

2. Open that work order and open its invoice — the “Print” / view-invoice action on the invoiced work order. Read the invoice as it appears on screen (the on-screen invoice, not a downloaded PDF file — a saved PDF of it may not be text-searchable).

3. Read the whole invoice document.

4. Look through it for any money — dollar amounts, labour rates, part sell prices, tax, or totals.
custom_expected:
1. The invoice document shows no pricing of any kind: no dollar amounts, no rate columns, no part sell prices, no tax, and no totals.

2. Searching the invoice returns no money values.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-7388 (Custom Roles and Permissions), story SV-7523 (Permission: See Financial Data — “OFF: all financial data hidden across every page”) and task SV-7484 ([CRP-BE-09] seeFinancialData enforcement chokepoint — acceptance: a Fin-OFF user gets payloads with no sellPrice/cost/margin keys, including the PDF paths), read on 10 September 2026.

Last checked against the staging build on 9/10/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
